display.title: Financial Accounting and Reporting: Fundamentals
display.author: Zeus Vernon B. Millan
display.paragraph: A foundation in recording business transactions and preparing financial reports. This preview introduces the accounting cycle and the information presented in financial statements, helping beginning accounting and business students understand how financial records describe an organization's activities, resources, obligations, and operating results.

Planning, organizing, leading, and controlling provide a practical framework for understanding decisions, teamwork, and organizational performance, making the subject useful for students preparing for supervisory or entrepreneurial roles.
